Version_comment: Two draggable cargo lines: a belt-tagged one for shapes and a pipe-tagged one for fluids, the latter because a fluid train station will only snap to a pipe connector. Corners chosen automatically. Packagers and unpackagers for both, and detours so every train station accepts cargo packages directly. Adds a Cargo Store that buffers 25 packages per layer, 75 in all, in three independent queues. No lifts yet, so cargo lines cannot cross each other.
Title: Train Cargo Tools
Description: Pack shapes or fluids into train cargo packages and carry them on cargo belts, so cargo can be buffered outside a train station. Stations accept packages directly.
Author: Quinn Bast
